criteria.reason: The workout exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option.
Selecting it opens a confirmation modal before applying the skip.
The client submits every current-week set with status `skipped`, and the server persists that status.
When all current-week sets are skipped, the exercise displays a “Skipped” label.
The menu offers “Resume Exercise” for a skipped exercise and clears its skipped state.
The existing `/sets` endpoint handles skipped status updates.
No new server test for skip or unskip appears in the diff.
No new client test for skip UI appears in the diff.
The reported server and client test suites both pass.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
